interview.hardest_part: Multi-step puzzle sequencing and reliable navigation/interaction from screenshots, especially manipulating NPCs and carrying objects across areas.
interview.likely_failure: Getting stuck on an early garden task due to imprecise beak/neck aiming, occlusion, or failing to recognize task state and required next step.
interview.helpful_mechanics: Click-to-move reduces locomotion burden, visible interactable targets support direct clicking, Tab task list gives goals, and persistent world state allows incremental progress.
interview.harmful_mechanics: Fixed camera and occlusion obscure targets, real-time NPC timing and physics require precision, interactions lack explicit feedback, and long multi-stage objectives are hard to plan from single screenshots.
